original_text:
–In case of:–Fire Drill
–Fire
–Broken Glass
–Power Failure
–Lockdown
–Accident (Bodily Harm)
explanation: This slide lists various emergency situations that can arise in the laboratory, for which students must know the correct protocols. These emergencies include fire drills, actual fires, broken glass, power failures, school or building lockdowns, and physical accidents causing bodily harm.

questions.q: Which of the following is listed on the slide as a potential emergency situation in the lab?
opts: Wearing long pants and closed-toed shoes
questions.exp: The slide lists 'Broken Glass' and 'Power Failure' as emergency conditions alongside fires, drills, lockdowns, and bodily harm accidents.
